title: Arbayeen Kay Soghvaaro Alveda
body:
Arbayeen kay soghvaaro alveda
Akhri majlis hai yaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaatema bil khair chehlum ka huva
Alveda-e-ashkbaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbaro Asghar Ali ki zaamini
Naujawaano sheerkharo alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehtey thay ganj-e-shaheedan par haram
Fatima zehra kay pyaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala ki khaakh ko sounpaa tumhey
Arsh-e-aazam kay sitaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabr par betoun ki Zainab ney kaha
Maa watan jaathi hai pyaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar kahin laashay kahin qabrein kahin
Baymakaano baydayaaro alveda
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabr sey awaaz detay hain Hussain
Lo bahan Zainab sidhaaro alveda
